ios.desc:
SantaCalls — the jolly voice of the holiday season, right in your pocket!

Bring your family’s Christmas spirit to life with Better Call Santa. This magical app allows you to create a holiday memory like no other with a personalized call from Santa himself.* Children can share their holiday wishes, and parents can safely view their child’s wish list details — all through one easy-to-use app.

Key Features:
• Santa Calls: Connect with Santa through a festive phone call that’ll have your child’s eyes lighting up like twinkling holiday lights.*
• Language support: Santa can speak over 30 languages! I mean, he does travel all around the world so that's not a surprise. A list with all supported languages is available in the app.*
• Parents zone: Parents can see and review their child’s wishes in a secret list, ensuring a jolly experience for the entire family.

Download SantaCalls and capture the enchantment of the holidays today!

Terms of Service: https://www.mattsteele.co/upic/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.mattsteele.co/upic/privacy

*Calling Santa is a limited and premium feature and requires a valid subscription. Prices and terms are subject to change. Please review the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy before purchasing.
